acceptance_criteria: Cifar10DataConfig has a fixed split_seed separate from augmentation/shuffle seed; tests prove train/val indices are invariant across trial seeds; run_teacher_training seeds from run_config.seed for standalone and in-process reproducibility; tests cover deterministic repeated trial setup where practical; best checkpoint writes use explicit is_best and atomic replace.
